import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
acc = df[df.account_id=='Cmq7HEs'].copy()
d20 = acc[acc.date=='10/20/25']
prev = acc[acc.date.isin(['10/10/25','10/11/25','10/12/25','10/13/25','10/14/25','10/15/25','10/16/25','10/17/25','10/18/25','10/19/25'])]
keys = ['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']
g20 = d20.groupby(keys)[['unblended_cost','num_instances','price']].sum()
gp = prev.groupby(keys)[['unblended_cost','num_instances','price']].mean()
comp = pd.concat([gp, g20], axis=1)
comp.columns = ['prev_cost','prev_num','prev_price','d20_cost','d20_num','d20_price']
comp['delta'] = comp.d20_cost - comp.prev_cost
top = comp.sort_values('delta', ascending=False).head(5)
pd.set_option('display.width', 200)
print(top)
# check the top one across all days
row = top.index[0]
sel = acc[(acc.csp==row[0])&(acc.cloud_service==row[1])&(acc.application==row[2])&(acc.instance_family==row[3])]
print(sel[['date','unblended_cost','num_instances','price']])

    if len(set(d.values()))>1 or (len(d)<14 and 0 not in d.values()):
        pass

d20 = acc[acc.date=='10/20/25']
gp = prev.groupby(keys).size()
g20 = d20.groupby(keys).size()
diff = (gp.fillna(0) - g20.fillna(0)).fillna(0)
print(diff[diff!=0])
